verdict.rationale: Token2 publishes a dedicated bulk-enrollment tool (fido2_bulkenroll_entraid) that automates registering FIDO2 keys in Entra ID through the Graph API, with random PIN setting and result logging, plus a PowerShell/Graph automated-registration guide. Bulk support appears limited to this enrollment workflow; the fido2-manage CLI's operations and its JSON/CSV audit export are documented per device. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of batch operations across many keys or credentials beyond Entra enrollment (e.g., bulk passkey delete or PIN changes across a fleet), a detailed description of how the bulk tool handles multiple keys, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
